title: Versioned client protocol
statement: The system shall expose a documented, versioned client protocol for submitting GQL statements and controlling transactions (begin, commit, rollback).
rationale: GQL is a language, not a transport; clients need a stable protocol.

acceptance_criteria.text: The protocol specification is published with a version number, and the server rejects unsupported client protocol versions with a version-mismatch error.
A client can begin, commit and roll back a multi-statement transaction through the protocol.

notes: Open: transport (gRPC vs HTTP/2 vs custom binary).
